# Dream Islands

> Dream Islands is a wellness travel platform for Asia. A free Wellness Journey assessment (about 2 minutes) scores a guest's baseline across body, recovery, metabolic health, mind and risk, then matches them to wellness, longevity, sleep, stress-recovery and performance programmes at partner properties in Thailand, China, Indonesia, Singapore, the Philippines, Vietnam and Malaysia. The guest repeats the assessment after the stay to see what changed. Dream Islands is a destination marketing organisation (DMO). It does not provide medical or psychiatric care. Where medical services are included, they are delivered by licensed physicians and healthcare providers at partner clinics and retreat centres.

## Start here

- [Wellness Journey (assessment)](https://dreamislands.org/start): free, about 2 minutes, returns a Wellness Score and matched programmes.
- [How it works](https://dreamislands.org/how-wbs-works): before, during and after, and how the Wellness Baseline Score is built.
- [Browse all programmes](https://dreamislands.org/programs): filter by goal, track, destination and duration.
- [Destinations](https://dreamislands.org/destinations): Thailand, China, Indonesia, Singapore, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia.
- [Properties](https://dreamislands.org/properties): partner resorts, retreats, medical wellness centres and clinics.
- [Guides hub](https://dreamislands.org/guides): all guides below in one place.

## Tracks

- [Reset & Recovery](https://dreamislands.org/tracks/reset-recovery): rest, detox, sleep again
- [Performance](https://dreamislands.org/tracks/performance): train smarter, rebuild capacity
- [Mind Balance](https://dreamislands.org/tracks/mind-balance): calm the nervous system, restore focus
- [Island Immersion](https://dreamislands.org/tracks/island-immersion): longer stays that change routine
- [Sport & Chill](https://dreamislands.org/tracks/sport-chill): sport, recovery and leisure

## China wellness destinations

- [Mile Wellness Resort, Mile, Yunnan](https://dreamislands.org/properties/mile-wellness-resort): forest hot springs and 3-7 day wellness programmes
- [Pu'er Forest Wellness Base, Yunnan](https://dreamislands.org/properties/puer-forest-wellness-base): forest and tea-culture base, 3-5 day stays
- [Wyndham Jinghong Resort, Xishuangbanna](https://dreamislands.org/properties/xishuangbanna-jinghong-resort): resort with open-air hot springs, tropical gardens and Dai culture
- [Pu'er Forest & Tea Culture Wellness](https://dreamislands.org/programs/puer-forest-tea-wellness)
- [Xishuangbanna Hot Springs & Dai Culture Wellness](https://dreamislands.org/programs/xishuangbanna-hotsprings-dai-wellness)
- [Pu'er & Xishuangbanna Combined Wellness Journey](https://dreamislands.org/programs/puer-xishuangbanna-combined-journey)
- [Huizhou TCM workshop](https://dreamislands.org/properties/traditional-chinese-medicine-workshop-huizhou)
- [Better Migrate medical coordination, Xi'an](https://dreamislands.org/properties/better-migrate-medical-network)

## Featured partner properties

Partners are independently owned and operated. Dream Islands does not own or operate them.

- [Tanya Samui Holistic Health Retreat, Koh Samui, Thailand](https://dreamislands.org/tanya-samui): the longest-running partner (open since 2009) and the main operating case for WBS-guided matching. [FAQ](https://dreamislands.org/tanya-samui/faq): 23 Q&A covering the protocol, medical safety, payment and logistics.
- [Clinique La Prairie Phuket](https://dreamislands.org/properties/clinique-la-prairie-phuket): medical longevity programmes in Phuket, Thailand (pre-opening; programmes shown with supplier prices in CHF, availability on request).

## Medical tourism in China

Dream Islands coordinates the route; hospitals and physicians provide diagnosis and treatment. No treatment outcome is guaranteed.

- [Medical Tours to China for International Patients](https://dreamislands.org/medical/china): hospital and specialist matching, bilingual support, surgery coordination; service fees from RMB 3,500
- [Peking Union Medical College Hospital](https://dreamislands.org/medical/china/hospitals/peking-union-medical-college-hospital)
- [Fudan Zhongshan Hospital](https://dreamislands.org/medical/china/hospitals/fudan-zhongshan-hospital)
- [Ruijin Hospital](https://dreamislands.org/medical/china/hospitals/ruijin-hospital)
- [Xian International Medical Center](https://dreamislands.org/medical/china/hospitals/xian-international-medical-center)
- [Shanghai Jiahui International Hospital](https://dreamislands.org/medical/china/hospitals/shanghai-jiahui-international-hospital)
- [Peking University First Hospital](https://dreamislands.org/medical/china/hospitals/peking-university-first-hospital)
- [Peking University International Hospital](https://dreamislands.org/medical/china/hospitals/peking-university-international-hospital)
- [West China Hospital](https://dreamislands.org/medical/china/hospitals/west-china-hospital)
- [Sun Yat Sen University Hospital](https://dreamislands.org/medical/china/hospitals/sun-yat-sen-university-hospital)
- [Remote Medical Second Opinion from Hospitals in China](https://dreamislands.org/medical/china/guides/second-opinion-china): documents reviewed directly by a hospital in China; Dream Islands and Better Migrate coordinate
- [How Much Does Medical Treatment in China Cost?](https://dreamislands.org/medical/china/guides/cost-of-treatment-china)
- [How to Arrange Medical Treatment in China](https://dreamislands.org/medical/china/guides/how-to-arrange-treatment-china)
- [How to Choose a Hospital in China](https://dreamislands.org/medical/china/guides/how-to-choose-hospital-china)
- [Hospitals in China for International Patients](https://dreamislands.org/medical/china/guides/hospitals-china-international-patients)

## Legal

Dream Islands operates as a Destination Marketing Organization (DMO) promoting wellness travel. It does not provide medical or psychiatric services directly and is not a medical institution. Content on this site is informational only and does not constitute medical advice.
